Export writes friction entries as Markdown to stdout, one section per
entry, grouped by status. The resolved section is the tool's record of what
changed and who asked. By default it writes every entry; --status as for
list.

Usage:
  agent friction export [flags]

Examples:
  agent friction export
  agent friction export --status resolved

Flags:
      --by string       Only entries filed by this agent ("user" for people)
  -h, --help            help for export
      --kind string     Only this kind
      --status string   open, accepted, resolved, wontfix, duplicate, all; comma-separated (default: list open,accepted; export all)

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
